To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the students we studied are, in fact, a diverse group.

(1) the college students in the study were, in general, very satisfied with their lives; (2) their satisfaction was based on their ability to create a community of friends; (3) this community was based on a shared sense of individuality; (4) this community was created through the use of language; (5) the community was created by a process of negotiation; and (6) the community was maintained by a system of reciprocity.

the most important thing to students is the quality of their relationships with friends, and the most important thing about their relationships with friends is that they be close and that the friends be similar.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the social construction and reproduction of the self.
the ways in which the social and cultural contexts of college life shape the experiences and development of young men and women.
the social construction of gender and the social construction of sexuality.
